notes.title: A New Adult RPG, Spirits of Retarnia, is Now Available Fully Uncensored!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/91696482714626633ad05d34d34c8df3e3b987cf.jpg

If you're a fan of dungeon crawlers and gameplay focused eroge, then get ready for The Spirit Master of Retarnia from MangaGamer and Lunasoft!

Join the Spirit Master of Retarnia in saving the kingdom from the Demon World at the behest of your queen! 

 Explore classic, 3D dungeons with a host of five heroines, each with their own special abilities!
Power up with equipment uncovered in the dungeon, and customize your party's skills as they level up to create the best builds for your style!
 

It's time to take up your wand and vanquish those threatening harm to the realm!
